system.description:
Increases damage multiplier by striking at weaknesses.
Level 1: Damage Multiplier increases by 1
Level 2: Damage Multiplier increases by 2
Level 3: Damage Multiplier increases by 3
Level 4: Damage Multiplier increases by 4
Level 5: Damage Multiplier increases by 5
Level 6: Damage Multiplier increases by 6
